desc: Derive the exact optimal-play criterion for determining whether Fennec or Snuke wins.
Prove the criterion, including how players should use repeated decrements to control whose turn performs the final unseen-index visit.
Check the formula against all samples and important edge cases such as \(N=1\), all \(A_i=1\), and highly unbalanced values.
Design an efficient implementation within \(N\le2\times10^5\) and \(A_i\le10^9\), including safe integer handling.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python solution enclosed in the requested code delimiters.
